description: This Kotlin source file defines an object 'AvatarLoader' responsible for loading user avatar images into ImageView widgets in an Android application. It uses the Glide library to handle image loading and transformation, and constructs avatar URLs based on user account information.

classes.name: AvatarLoader
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to load user avatar images into ImageViews, supporting different input parameters such as Account objects and URLs.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an avatar image into the provided ImageView based on the Account object.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an avatar image into the provided ImageView based on the Account object and a username, constructing the avatar URL accordingly.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an avatar image into the provided ImageView from a given URL or URI, applying circle crop transformation and placeholders.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs the avatar URL based on the base URL and username, encoding the username for URL safety.
